name: Mizutani Yukari
source:
Class: 1st year student in the regular class
Zodiac Sign: Aquarius
Musical Instrument: Piano
Hobbies: Playing the piano, baking (making sweets)

A virtuoso genius pianist. She is so shy she is too shy to play the piano in front of people she doesn't know, and sometimes even too shy talk to them.
She was planning to attend the special advance class along with her older sister Haruka, but she ended up going to the regular class after failing to take the admission exam.
Yukari uses honorifics when addressing to her classmates. She is characterized by polite demeanor, low tone and the naivness that suits a young lady.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=660669]Getchu (NSFW)[/url].]
